# metronome_custom_field_key (Resource)

A custom field key: permission to set a custom field of that name on one kind of object. Metronome refuses a custom field whose key has not been added.

~> **Nothing about a key can change**; changing an attribute replaces it.

~> **Destroying a key deletes it** (this one thing Metronome does delete), and **every value stored under it stops being readable**. Replacing a key does the same.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lets a credit carry the key of what caused it.
resource "metronome_custom_field_key" "grant_key" {
  entity             = "contract_credit"
  key                = "grant_key"
  enforce_uniqueness = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enforce_uniqueness` (Boolean) Whether Metronome refuses a value that another object of the kind already has under this key.
- `entity` (String) The kind of object, for example `customer`, `contract`, `commit` or `contract_credit` (a credit).
- `key` (String) The custom field's name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<entity>/<key>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import metronome_custom_field_key.grant_key contract_credit/grant_key
```
